Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner initially decided to treat Anthony Asquith as the director of the film based on a "first-listed-director heuristic" without verifying which director was actually responsible for the specific film version in question. This led to confusion and misdirection in the subsequent steps, as it was later clarified that Willi Forst directed the 1933 version Leise flehen meine Lieder, which is the film most commonly associated with Gently My Songs Entreat. This initial misidentification set off a chain of incorrect assumptions and decisions throughout the conversation.
